title: E-MenuX
description:
一个简单的菜单插件
A simple menu plugin
body:
**（这个插件是二次创作的）**

这个插件**使用了插件“Menux”的逻辑**，并向MenuX的逻辑中添加了对玩家头颅（player_head）的处理，使其可以给玩家头颅添加主人，显示那个人的皮肤，并向其添加**自定义提示**的功能，所有游戏内提示通过_lang.yml_可以**自定义**

**(This plugin is a secondary creation)**

This plugin  **uses the logic of the plugin "Menux"** , and adds processing to the player's head (playeryhead) to the logic of MenuX, allowing it to add an owner to the player's head, display that person's skin, and add the function of  **custom prompts**  to it. All in-game prompts can be **customized through** _lang.xml_
